“Oil seal” is a shape, not a medium
The trade name covers every rotary shaft lip seal to DIN 3760, whatever it seals. In EPDM these run on water, coolant, steam and glycol — and not on mineral oil, which swells EPDM.
Shaft diameter, housing bore, width — and Type A or AS depending on whether you need a dust lip. Send those four and we can quote; a drawing is optional.
Tell us about the shaft, not just the seal
Surface finish, hardness and running speed decide how long a lip lasts. A badly ground shaft destroys a correct seal in weeks — so we ask about it before quoting, not afterwards.
The lip has to spring back
A shaft seal works because the lip recovers against its garter spring. We test compression set in-house to ASTM D395 Method B — a lip that takes a set stops sealing while it still looks perfect.

Compound datasheets and dimensioned drawings are issued on request, under NDA where required. Send shaft diameter, housing bore, width and the medium, and we will confirm the type and compound against them.
What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted against the part where geometry or tooling makes that unrealistic. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send the old seal and, if you can, tell us how it failed — a hardened, cracked lip means heat, a grooved lip means an abrasive medium, and a polished band on the shaft means the shaft is the problem, not the seal. We size from the housing and the shaft, not from the worn part.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?

PDF, DWG, DXF and STEP — but a drawing is often unnecessary. Shaft diameter, housing bore, width, type A or AS, plus the medium and shaft speed is a complete specification. Add the shaft surface finish if you have it.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house, with dimensions checked against DIN 3760.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?

TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment. Seals are packed to protect the sealing lip.
